feedback: The proposed tests fully cover the core requirements of the calculator as specified in the customer intent. Test case R014-T01 validates basic addition with positive integers, R014-T02 verifies correct application of operator precedence (multiplication before addition), and R014-T03 confirms proper handling of parentheses to override precedence. All tests use valid, well-formed expressions with nonnegative integers and respect the output formatting rules (integer output without decimal point, no leading zeros). The tests are directly aligned with the examples provided in the requirement and exercise the key arithmetic behaviors. No additional tests are needed to validate the stated requirements. The mathematical reference checks are not required here as the examples are self-contained and verifiable by simple arithmetic. Coverage is complete and justified.
